turns.message: I ordered a Fujifilm X-T5 mirrorless camera worth Rs. 1,43,000 through Amazon from the seller Clicktech Retail. It was delivered on 10-02-2025, but the box contained a different model, an X-T50, and the package had two conflicting labels. I told them immediately. They agreed to take it back and refund me, the camera was collected from my home, and the seller received it on 20-02-2025. They still refused to refund Rs. 1,43,000. Customer support told me an investigation had cleared them and claimed I had returned the wrong product. On 21-02-2025 Amazon emailed me that the returned item was used and damaged. I sent photographs of the conflicting labels, but the refund request was rejected without a valid reason.

expected.rationale: Refund denied, exact return date, support contacted, grievance officer not mentioned.
